description: Parse locale-formatted money text (1.234,56, 1,00,000, accounting parentheses) without guessing — Parses up to 100 number or money strings such as "1.234,56", "1,00,000", "(1,234.50)", "￥1,000" or "CHF 1'234.50" into canonical decimal strings, for an agent reading amounts from documents, emails or tables. With a BCP 47 locale it applies that locale's CLDR separators (read from Intl.NumberFormat); without one it lists every valid reading and an ambiguous string such as "1,234" returns unknown w

currency.description: Expected currency; resolves an ambiguous symbol and fails a contradicting one.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag whose CLDR separators apply, e.g. de-DE, en-IN, de-CH.

name: locale-number
